jobs.description:
Who We Are
DB Global Technology, Deutsche Bank's technology center in Central and Eastern Europe, opened its Bucharest office in January 2014 and is continuously expanding. The team comprises enthusiastic professionals working in an international environment, dedicated to learning new technologies and fundamentally changing how Deutsche Bank operates.
We are looking for a talented and passionate Backend Engineer to join our uFlow team within the Service Solution & AI and Services tribe. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining core application modules for uFlow, a critical component of our service offerings. This is a hands-on position where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and directly impact the success of our products.
What You’ll Be Doing
Design & Development: Design and develop core application modules using Java, Spring Boot, Camunda/Fluxnova, and Oracle DB.
Requirements Gathering: Participate in client and stakeholder meetings to understand business needs and translate them into robust technical requirements.
Task Estimation: Decompose complex tasks into manageable units and provide accurate effort estimations.
Quality Assurance: Identify and resolve bugs, write comprehensive unit tests, and perform code reviews to ensure high-quality delivery.
DevOps Support: Help maintain the technical infrastructure, including continuous integration and automated deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
Mentorship: Conduct peer code reviews and mentor junior team members to foster a culture of continuous learning.
Innovation: Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends in backend development.
What We’re Looking For
Bachelor or Master Degree in computer science or similar
Minimum of 5+ years of professional software development experience in Java.
Core Concepts: Strong understanding of Java Core concepts, multithreading, and software design patterns.
Frameworks & APIs: Solid experience working with Spring, Hibernate, and RESTful APIs.
Build Tools: Proficiency with build automation tools such as Maven or Gradle.
Collaboration Tools: Experience using JIRA, Git (Stash/Bitbucket), and Confluence for project management and collaboration.
Databases: Practical experience with relational databases, specifically Oracle DB, and basic-to-intermediate SQL knowledge.
Soft Skills: Excellent communication and presentation skills, a proactive problem-solving attitude, and a strong desire to learn.
Nice To Have
BPM Tools: Hands-on experience with BPM engines (Camunda or Fluxnova preferred).
Cloud Platforms: Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Advanced DB: Strong SQL optimization skills and experience with advanced database concepts.
Containers: Experience with OpenShift, Kubernetes, or Helm for container orchestration.
Leadership: Demonstrated technical leadership skills or experience mentoring junior engineers.

jobs.title: Full-stack Technical Lead (Java+React)
jobs.description:
N-iX is a global software development service company that helps businesses across the globe create next-generation software products. Founded in 2002, we unite 2,400+ tech-savvy professionals across 40+ countries, working on impactful projects for industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Our expertise spans cloud, data, AI/ML, embedded software, IoT, and more, driving digital transformation across finance, manufacturing, telecom, healthcare, and other industries. Join N-iX and become part of a team where your ideas make a real impact.
Nowadays, finding a long-term job with an interesting project can feel like a real challenge.
But hey — if you're an experienced
Technical Lead / Full Stack Engineer (Java + React)
, look no further!
Yes, it's real. You're not dreaming. Miracles do exist!
When it comes to our customer – a strategic partner of ours in the integrated Shipping Services. They have set themselves apart as an independent carrier with a fresh, unique approach. Their strategy as a global niche carrier offers distinctive advantages to customers worldwide. We have created a smart, efficient network that ensures stable, reliable services; and we have made it our mission to focus on the needs of our customers, which stand at the heart of all our decisions. The main idea of our product operates in select trades, where it has a competitive advantage and where it can provide superior service. We maintain a flexible partnership approach with other major carriers, and our new line structure is a much-needed alternative to customers concerned about the current alliance-dominated market.
Responsibilities:
Guide, mentor, and foster the growth of full-stack engineers within the team, championing engineering excellence and XP practices.
Lead the architectural design and technical direction of innovative full-stack applications, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with business goals.
Establish and champion high standards of code quality, testing (TDD/BDD), CI/CD pipelines, and robust DevOps practices.
Act as a key technical point of contact, collaborating closely with product owners and stakeholders to translate complex requirements into actionable technical strategies.
Direct full-stack development of innovative applications, remaining actively involved in writing code and remote pairing.
Own the entire development cycle, including design, architecture, development, testing, and DevOps deployment.
Foster a highly collaborative Extreme Programming (XP) environment featuring remote pairing and rapid feedback loops.

BS degree
in Computer Science or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

6+ years
of full-stack development experience.

of experience in the following technologies: Java, Spring.

jobs.title: Java Architect with German
jobs.description:
Who We Are
We don't have the fame, but we've got the flame. We are a distributed group of specialists within NTT DATA Romania, who make the best out of JVM-based technologies, creativity and business solutions. Referred to as Java Competence Center, we co-create and co-accelerate with key players in any field. Without being limited to any business unit, we demonstrated our deep Java development expertise by delivering SaaS platforms in various domains: Web Applications in e-Commerce, Automotive, Telco, Insurance, Banking and Public sector, even Big Data and scientific applications.
We’re looking for a Java Software Architect to join a well-established player in the financial and accounting software space, operating under a model where profits are reinvested into technology, platform evolution, and long-term stability. In this role, you will: design and evolve scalable and resilient distributed systems; guide system integrations across complex environments and act as a bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, translating requirements into robust architectural solutions. You will operate at the intersection of technology, business, and regulation, shaping architectures that must be both flexible and audit-ready in a highly regulated environment. If you’re motivated by complex systems, real trade-offs, and high-impact decisions—we should talk.
What You'll Be Doing
Architecture Development: Define and evolve the target software and solution architecture, ensuring alignment with business goals and seamless integration with existing systems
Cloud & IT Architecture: Design and guide cloud architecture and overall IT system architecture, ensuring scalability, security, and reliability
Bridging Role (Brückenkopf): Act as a link between business stakeholders, Product Owners, and development teams to translate requirements into architectural solutions
Microservices Architecture: Design and govern microservices architectures to improve scalability, flexibility, and maintainability
Collaboration: Work closely with client architects and teams to align on architectural standards and decisions
Documentation: Maintain clear architectural documentation, including design decisions and system landscapes
Quality & Governance: Establish best practices for architecture, code quality, testing, and deployment across the lifecycle
What You'll Bring Along
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
Around 10 years of experience in software engineering, with a strong focus on architecture and system design
Proven expertise in software, cloud, IT system, microservices, and solution architecture
Strong understanding of cloud-native and distributed systems design principles
Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and modern deployment practices
Knowledge of messaging technologies (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ)
Experience with build and CI/CD tools (e.g., Maven, automation pipelines)
Solid experience with databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL)
Familiarity with testing strategies and automation
Strong communication skills in English and German, with the ability to act as a bridge between teams
Ability to work independently and manage complex architectural challenges efficiently

jobs.title: Java Developer
jobs.description:
Who We Are
Everything at BMW TechWorks Romania begins with passion. It transforms a job into a calling. It motivates us to continually reinvent mobility and bring new ideas to life and onto the roads. Passion for collaborative projects turns a team into a strong unit where every viewpoint is appreciated.
Whatever you aspire to, at BMW TechWorks Romania we live and breathe software and we offer a wide variety of departments and fields where you can share your professional passion with us. By delivering software all the way from the idea to the final product, we lead BMW into the future of digitalization and mobility. And this also means:
We search for excellence
We get involved
We keep it simple
We share trust
Join BMW TechWorks Romania on our journey of innovation and excellence as we redefine the future of motion, one product at a time. Our engineers are vital to the innovation and digitalization of BMW Group's driving machines, production, sales and banking processes, and you could be part of our evolving teams.
What Awaits You
Design, develop, and deploy Java-based applications, ensuring high performance, responsiveness, and scalability
Implement API integrations with various external systems using RESTful and SOAP protocols, ensuring seamless communication and data exchange
Developing business logic based on JEE using applications servers
Optimize application performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure efficient utilization of resources in cloud environments
Implement security best practices and standards to protect data and systems against potential threats and vulnerabilities
Write clean, well-documented code and adhere to coding standards and guidelines
Define and document data models for the applications
Using test driven development techniques
Using and maintaining a CI/CD pipeline
Deploying the application to a Kubernetes cluster
Working in an Agile team using Scrum/Kanban methodology and their derivatives
Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and other Agile/Scrum ceremonies to ensure high-quality deliverables and on-time project completion
End-to-end responsibility for application development
Stay updated with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices to continuously improve skills and contribute to the team's success
Transform business requirements into structured technical specifications
Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, and QA engineers to refine requirements
What Should You Bring Along
University Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field
At least 5 years of experience on a similar Java Developer role is required
Mandatory skills: MCP + Skills + Agents, PostgreSQL or similar, Data Mapping, VSCode + Github or similar IDE
Experience in development with Java SE 11+
JUnit experience and knowledge
Relational Database concepts and usage (PostgreSQL or other), NoSQL concepts and usage (MongoDB or other), Migration tools (e.g. Flyway)
Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools for CI/CD, automated testing, and deployment (Jenkins, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
Nice to have: AWS/Azure, Terraform
Good understanding of software design principles, design patterns, and best practices
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Excellent English verbal and written skills
German communication skills will be a plus
What do we offer?
Challenging projects with which we are shaping the mobility of tomorrow
Great team spirit within an international team
State-of-the-art global IT landscape and processes
100% implementation of the Agile Working Model methodology
Wide range of personal & professional development opportunities
High level of job security
Work-Life-Balance and flexible working hours
At BMW TechWorks Romania, we view diversity and inclusion in all its forms as a cornerstone of our team's strength. Equal opportunities are a priority, and fair treatment of all applicants and employees is a fundamental principal of our corporate policy. Our recruitment decisions ensure a balanced and inclusive approach, valuing our people’s different personalities and skills, experience and viewpoints, regardless of sexual orientation, national origin or citizenship, gender identity, age, race, color, ethnicity, religion, or disability.
